introduction: Follow four independent food offerings to the elder hierophant and explore the forest’s refuge, foraging, wildlife, friendship, forestry, ancient guardians, promised freedom, canopy and river stories.
orientation: Discover the forest from its current Surface entrance, learn the light and dense paths, and keep a verified way back as you explore the river and ancient tree.
The elder hierophant accepts blackberries, a small yellow mushroom, a chunk of meat or a large chunk of meat. Each is its own offering; you do not need all four foods together.
Prepare one exact food loose in your inventory for its matching offering. A different food, an equipped berry or a packed-away material does not satisfy that current preparation.
A food recovered from its source or an exact copy supplied by another player fits the matching native request. A supplied copy does not claim your own first harvest or personal kill.
Mushrooms and berries are hidden native room materials. Finding a described bush or mushroom does not guarantee current stock or prove that you personally recovered a particular item.
Only selected deer and doe source rows carry the small meat, while the centaur supplies the large meat. Other wildlife and every deer are not interchangeable sources.
An accepted offering stays recorded after its food is spent. The promised experience amount, your actual saved reward and a useful effect on the hierophant are separate evidence.
Eating the food yourself uses its own effects and consumes it. That does not count as offering it to the hierophant, curing his hunger or completing a friendship.
Cvok and the scarred clearing suggest forestry and restoration. Meeting him, seeing logs or defeating a tree does not yet prove useful work or a recovered habitat.

Ancient trees, dark trunks and webbed branches form distinct routes. Follow the actual exits, preserve travel and combat costs, and keep a way down; scenery alone does not create a door or a climbing quest.
Zriaxa’s promise of freedom points to a longer story. Following, charm or ordinary combat does not yet record liberation; protecting specific living recipients needs further integration.

The dark river, forest refuge and damaged trees suggest care and rescue. An admitted crossing, surviving return and useful saved recipient or habitat outcome need distinct evidence before deeper stories can be completed.

contacts.name: a green snake
contacts.description: This relatively harmless snake has bright alternating bands of red, yellow and black.

contacts.name: the elder hierophant
contacts.description: The elder hierophant welcomes four different foods in independent offerings. One exact recovered or supplied food fits its own request; the accepted exchange is separate from a lasting friendship or benefit to the forest.

contacts.name: a large doe
contacts.description: This peaceful creature looks at you with big dark eyes.

contacts.name: a brown bear
contacts.description: The bear is a big, brown, furry animal with very large claws and very sharp teeth.

contacts.name: a brown fox
contacts.description: It is a large fox with beautiful, red-brown fur and a long, thick brush.

contacts.name: a vicious wolf
contacts.description: It is an exceptionally large wolf with thick, black fur.

contacts.name: a swarm of insects
contacts.description: These insects are more of an annoyance than a threat.

contacts.name: a fallow deer
contacts.description: She is a graceful creature on long, slender legs, and with large, brown eyes looking back at you with an air of watchful interest.

contacts.name: a wild dog
contacts.description: A beast is the size of the largest common dog.

contacts.name: a field mouse
contacts.description: This mouse is about the length of your hand, with sharp teeth, which it uses to bite.

contacts.name: a young horse
contacts.description: The horse whinnies at you, then runs around you a few times, then just goes back to grazing.

contacts.name: a huge skeletal tree
contacts.description: This enormous tree must be a thousand years old.

contacts.name: a huge skeletal tree
contacts.description: This enormous tree must be a thousand years old.

contacts.name: an old oak tree
contacts.description: The old tree looks as though the wind has battered and torn at it for years.

contacts.name: a colossal tree
contacts.description: The old tree looks as though the wind has battered and torn at it for years.

contacts.name: Cvok the Lumberjack
contacts.description: Cvok is a lumberjack whose surroundings suggest logging and damaged woodland. Meeting him and seeing the clearing guide a possible restoration story; useful work needs further integration.

contacts.name: a grey cat
contacts.description: The grey cat cocks an ear towards you, sensing your scrutiny, then purrs contentedly.

contacts.name: the wandering centaur hunter
contacts.description: The centaur is a native source of the large chunk of meat. Current location and material supply depend on actual admission and movement; carrying meat or a saddle does not establish personal recovery.

contacts.name: the spider queen, Zriaxa
contacts.description: Queen Zriaxa speaks of freedom for the forest inhabitants. Existing followers and reaching her tree top do not yet prove a completed liberation or a saved benefit to a living recipient.

contacts.name: a spider slave
contacts.description: The yound spider slave looks freshly hatched and sprightly.

contacts.name: a horned lizard
contacts.description: This scaly creature looks like it is well adapted to its forest habitat.

contacts.name: a sparrow
contacts.description: The sparrow has brown feathers and small wings, looks like it is enjoying life.

contacts.name: a large python
contacts.description: It looks really disgusting and doesn't smell very nice either.

contacts.name: a small wood turtle
contacts.description: The turtle is small in size and has hard scales on its body,it looks most of all like a tiny scaled creature.

contacts.name: a drone spider
contacts.description: A small brown and green slime covered spider.
